attributes.action: Railings to be put in place up both sides of the Road on Dee Road Hill Tilehurst
attributes.additional_details: This hill is extremely dangerous with parents parking on pathways where children are walking. Putting railings or barriers up the hill will keep the children safe, and allow for safer parking. Because there are two primary schools on this hill the amount of cars on pavements is extremely dangerous posing a huge risk to the children. The barriers to be placed between the grass and pavement allowing the cars to park but creating the safe walking pathway
attributes.background: There needs to be railings or barriers up both sides of Dee Road Hill in Tilehurst. There are two primary schools on this hill and there have been a number of accidents involving school children the most recent ones were in October 2026 and the  today the 25th November 2026
